algorithm: SHA256(domain || seed || epoch_u64_le || center_u64_le), minimum digest then minimum center
population: All epoch-978 center slots whose three-slot window stays inside the epoch and does not overlap the previously inspected engineering interval. Missing index entries are not excluded.
estimand: Pilot completeness, bounded decoder coverage and field availability for one randomly selected contiguous window; no strategy or regime-generalization estimand.
selection_inputs: Seed, epoch geometry and prior-engineering exclusions ONLY. Index bytes are read for feasibility AFTER center selection.
time_catalogue: UNAVAILABLE: no verified epoch UTC interval or market-regime catalogue; slot is chain order, not a UTC duration.
context_limit: One preceding and one following slot preserve local boundaries only. They do not establish token creation, a full lifecycle, observation latency or a later executable opportunity.
expansion_rule: NONE. At most this one three-slot window. No replacement, new seed or extra window after seeing bytes, Pump presence, returns or decode outcomes. Any future larger design is a separately frozen proposal, not a replacement of missing observations.
stop_rules: selected index entry absent or invalid
decoder or writer cap exceeded: keep all input and report incomplete, never truncate
unknown or unsupported records remain in denominators; no resampling
research_promotion: BLOCKED: current Bronze and Parquet explicitly admit ENGINEERING_VALIDATION_ONLY. A reviewed sample-class propagation and completeness contract is needed; never relabel existing engineering data.
